popover.label: Page tour
popover.disabledFallback: This control is not available right now.

waiting.title: Loading this part of the page…
waiting.body: The tour carries on as soon as it appears.

lost.title: This item changed or is no longer on the page
lost.body: You can go on to the next step, go back, or leave the tour.

completed.title: You're done
completed.body: You can take this tour again whenever you like from Support.

announce.skipped: Skipped: {{title}} is not available right now
announce.movedPage: Tour closed because you moved to another page

panel.title: Help for {{page}}
panel.noHelpBody: A guided tour for this screen is on its way. The rest of the application works as usual.
panel.noPage: No help for this screen yet

search.title: Search {{subject}}
search.body: Type part of a name, number or phrase to narrow {{subject}}. The list updates as you type; clear the box to see everything again.
search.when: When you know roughly what you are looking for.

filterSelect.title: Filter {{subject}}
filterSelect.body: Choose a value to show only the matching entries. Filters can be combined, and choosing the first option clears the filter.
filterSelect.when: When the list is long and you only need one group.

dateRange.title: Choose a date range
dateRange.body: Pick a start and an end date to show only what falls between them. Leave a side empty for no limit.
dateRange.when: When you are looking at a particular week, month or period.

statusChips.title: Filter by status
statusChips.body: Each chip shows the entries with that status. Select one to filter; select it again to clear.
statusChips.when: When you only care about entries at one stage.

sortHeader.title: Sort by this column
sortHeader.body: Select the heading to sort {{subject}} by it. Select it again to reverse the order.
sortHeader.when: When you want the newest, the largest or the first alphabetically at the top.

pagination.title: Move between pages
pagination.body: Shows which entries you are seeing and how many there are. Use the arrows or a page number to move, and the size menu to show more or fewer at a time.
pagination.when: When {{subject}} does not fit on one page.
pagination.disabled: A direction is dimmed when there is nothing further that way.

rowMenu.title: Actions for one entry
rowMenu.body: Opens the actions available for this entry. What you see depends on what you are allowed to do.
rowMenu.when: When you want to act on one entry without opening it.
rowMenu.disabled: A dimmed action is not available for this entry right now.

statusBadge.title: Status
statusBadge.body: Shows where this entry stands right now. It changes as the work moves forward.

tabs.title: Tabs
tabs.body: Each tab shows a different part of {{subject}}. Select a tab to switch; the one you are on is highlighted.
tabs.when: When the information you want is in another section.

bulkSelect.title: Select several
bulkSelect.body: Tick the boxes to choose more than one entry, or the box in the header to choose everything on this page. Actions for the selection appear once something is chosen.
bulkSelect.when: When the same action applies to many entries.
bulkSelect.disabled: Some entries cannot be selected because you may not act on them.

export.title: Export
export.body: Downloads {{subject}} as a file you can open in a spreadsheet. It exports what the filters currently show.
export.when: When you need the data outside the application.
export.disabled: Exporting is not available right now.

refresh.title: Refresh
refresh.body: Loads the latest {{subject}} from the server. The page also refreshes itself after you save a change.
refresh.when: When someone else may have changed something.
refresh.disabled: A refresh is already in progress.

backLink.title: Go back
backLink.body: Returns to the previous screen. Anything you have not saved on this one is not kept.
backLink.when: When you are done here or opened the wrong entry.

saveBar.title: Save or discard
saveBar.body: Save stores your changes; Discard throws them away. Nothing is saved until you press Save.
saveBar.when: When you have finished filling in the form.
saveBar.disabled: Save is dimmed until the required fields are filled in correctly.

confirmDialog.title: Confirm before it happens
confirmDialog.body: This window asks you to confirm because the action cannot easily be undone. Read the message, then confirm or cancel. The tour never presses these for you.
confirmDialog.when: Whenever you are about to delete or close something.

emptyAction.title: Nothing here yet
emptyAction.body: This list is empty. The button below starts the first entry, so you can add one straight away.
emptyAction.when: The first time you use this page.
emptyAction.disabled: Adding is not available to your role.

menu.title: Menu button
menu.body: Opens the main menu on a phone. On a larger screen the menu is always visible on the left.

nav.title: Main menu
nav.body: The places you can go. The list shows only what your role allows, so it may differ from a colleague's.

navItem.title: A menu entry
navItem.body: Select an entry to open that part of the application. The highlighted one is where you are now. A number beside an entry counts things waiting for you, such as overdue follow-ups.

theme.title: Appearance
theme.body: Switches between light, dark and the setting of your device. It changes only how the application looks for you.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.body: Shows what has happened that concerns you, such as assignments and approvals. A number on the bell counts the unread ones; selecting a notification opens the item it is about.

script.title: Sales script
script.body: Opens the sales script beside the page, so you can read it during a call. It stays open as you move between pages until you close it.

support.title: Support
support.body: Opens help for the page you are on: a guided tour of this page, or an explanation of one control.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.body: Opens a menu with your settings and the way to sign out.

logout.title: Log out
logout.body: Ends your session on this device. Anything you have not saved is not kept.
